A '''species''' of [[Monkey/Legends|monkey]]-like [[Species/Legends|creatures]] inhabited the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. They possessed [[Color/Legends|green]] and yellow skin, with a row of brown spikes running down their back. The species also had long, [[Limb/Legends|prehensile tails]], sharp [[Claw/Legends|claws]], and pointed [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. They seemed to primarily dwell in trees and were proficient in both jumping and climbing.<ref name="2-11"/>

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated series, which include the events of "Hard Sell," to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ewok]]s [[Latara]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] approached a group of these creatures in an attempt to sell them a type of automated mixer, though unable to understand their sales pitch, one of the creatures swallowed the device whole before grabbing [[Latara]]. They attempted to carry her up and off into the trees, though she was saved by the Kneesa's quick thinking, who had thrown a grappling rope for her friend to grab onto.<ref name="2-11"/>

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The creature first appeared in "[[Hard Sell]]," the eleventh episode of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated series,<ref name="2-11"/> which first aired on the [[ABC Television Network]] on [[September 7]], [[1985]].<ref name="A Star Wars CELibration">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
